The image is a microscopic view showing:
- Brown, thick, segmented, branching hyphae/sporangiophores
- Two dark spherical structures: one on the right is a smooth, intact black sporangium on a stalk; one on the left is a rougher, brownish structure (likely a sporangium that has begun releasing spores)

These are classic Rhizopus microscopy features: sporangiophores bearing black, round sporangia. The knowledge base description for Rhizopus Soft Rots specifically mentions "whitish-gray mycelia with black sporangia" — the black sporangia on stalks visible here are the definitive diagnostic feature.
